name: 45833 · Delphos, OH
findings: ZIP 45833 (Delphos) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45833 (Delphos) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45833 (Delphos) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
